technique_name: Summarize the recent development in the field of automated driving.
description: Recent advances in automated driving technologies have enabled vehicles to be driven autonomously in a wide range of scenarios. This includes highway driving, urban and rural settings, and even indoors. Automated technologies have improved vehicle safety, enabling vehicles to detect and respond to potential threats faster than a human driver.
